rows.ProposalDescription1:
Scope of Work

Project: Tif 419 Bermuda Sod Installation
Area: Approximately 5,000 square feet
Sod: TifTuf Bermuda
Irrigation: Temporary irrigation system for establishment

1. Site Preparation

  • Mobilize labor, equipment, and materials to the project site.

  • Verify approximately 5,000 SF of area designated for sod installation.

  • Remove existing vegetation, weeds, debris, rocks, and unsuitable surface material as required.

  • Rough-grade and fine-grade the installation area to provide positive drainage and a smooth, uniform surface.

  • Establish final grades to accommodate the finished sod height and surrounding grades.

2. Soil Preparation

  • Loosen and prepare the existing soil to promote proper root establishment.

  • Import and install suitable screened topsoil/planting soil where required to achieve proper grade and growing conditions.

  • Spread and fine-grade soil uniformly.

  • Remove rocks, roots, and debris from the finished planting surface.

  • Final soil preparation shall provide a firm, smooth surface suitable for sod installation.

3. Tif 419 Bermuda Sod Installation

  • Furnish and install approximately 5,000 SF of Tif 419 Bermuda sod.

  • Sod shall be fresh, healthy, well-rooted, and free of weeds, disease, and significant damage.

  • Install sod tightly together with staggered joints to minimize visible seams.

  • Cut and fit sod neatly around structures, curbs, walks, irrigation components, and other obstructions.

  • Roll or tamp newly installed sod to ensure good contact between the sod and prepared soil.

  • Water sod immediately following installation.

4. Temporary Irrigation

  • Furnish and install a temporary irrigation system adequate to provide uniform coverage of the entire 5,000 SF sod area.

  • System may consist of temporary above-ground hoses, sprinklers, risers, timers, and associated fittings as appropriate for site conditions.

  • Adjust sprinkler locations and coverage to minimize dry areas and excessive runoff.

  • Program irrigation to maintain adequate moisture during the establishment period.

  • Inspect and adjust the temporary irrigation system as needed during establishment.

  • Temporary irrigation shall remain in place for the agreed establishment period and then be removed unless otherwise directed.
